key_points: MetLife declared its quarterly dividend of $0.5925 per share, payable Dec. 8, 2026.
UBS raised its price target for MET to $110, maintaining a Buy rating.
TD Cowen also raised its price target to $110 with a positive forecast.
Argent Capital Management LLC purchased 121,303 shares of MET, indicating institutional interest.
Various director share awards and deferred receipts were reported, routine compensation activity.
